scopeNote: Separates six questions that are routinely conflated: technical implementation, membership/licensing, manufacturer identification, product certification, approved terminology and logo use. MC-11 satisfies NONE of them.

nmea2000.technicalImplementation: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. No NMEA 2000 stack, CAN interface, PGN encoder/decoder or address-claiming logic exists in any MAREA product definition. The legacy OPEN-MARINE stack contains only a TypeScript interface union (socketcan/pcan/usbcan/native) and a no-op actuator stub, recorded as HW-09 NO_ARTICLE in docs/marea/compliance/HARDWARE-COMPLIANCE-MATRIX.md. Protocol-level interoperability is therefore NOT_TESTED and no statement of NMEA 2000 capability may be made.
nmea2000.membership: NOT_A_MEMBER. No NMEA membership, NMEA 2000 licence, NMEA 0183 standard licence or manufacturer mnemonic code has been purchased. D2 §4 invariants NMEA2000_CERTIFIED=false apply.
nmea2000.manufacturerIdentification: NOT_ASSIGNED. No NMEA 2000 manufacturer code and no product code exist. NMEA states manufacturer-code assignment takes up to 60 days (EVD-MC11-002). No application was filed in MC-11.
nmea2000.productCertification: NOT_CERTIFIED. NMEA states that all products that read and/or transmit NMEA 2000 information must be certified by NMEA and that certification is granted only after validation of an encrypted certification file (EVD-MC11-001). No certification tool run, no submission, no certificate.
nmea2000.approvedTerminology: PROHIBITED_TERMS_WITHHELD. The terms 'NMEA 2000 certified', 'NMEA 2000 compatible', 'NMEA 2000 approved' and any equivalent are prohibited in every MAREA artefact until certification exists. Permitted wording is descriptive only: 'NMEA 2000 is not implemented, not licensed and not certified by MAREA'.
nmea2000.logoUse: NOT_PERMITTED. The NMEA 2000 mark is a registered trademark of NMEA and NMEA states that logo and 'NMEA 2000 Certified' use follows certification (EVD-MC11-001). No MAREA asset may include the mark.
claimsPermitted: MAREA does not implement NMEA 2000 in any MC-11 product definition.
NMEA 2000 certification is required by NMEA for products that read and/or transmit NMEA 2000 information.
A candidate NMEA 2000 interface would require the NMEA 2000 license agreement, a manufacturer code and per-product certification before any compatibility claim.
claimsProhibited: NMEA 2000 compatible / compatible with NMEA 2000 networks
any logo, wordmark or look-alike mark

nmea0183.technicalImplementation: SENTENCE_PARSING_ONLY. Executed evidence in the audited legacy stack covers an MWV/MWD wind parser (unit tests) and a GNSS sentence parser (RMC/GGA/GSA/GSV/VTG, code only). No NMEA 0183 electrical-layer implementation (RS-422 differential talker/listener with opto-isolation) exists; USB-serial adapters were assumed. Parsing a sentence is not conformance to the standard and no conformance claim is made.
nmea0183.membership: NOT_A_MEMBER. NMEA 0183 is a copyrighted standard available only from NMEA; published prices are USD 1,150 for a manufacturer member, USD 7,500 government/industrial/testing and USD 10,000 consumer electronics (EVD-MC11-003). No copy was purchased, so the MAREA parser is written from public sentence documentation, not from the licensed standard text.
nmea0183.manufacturerIdentification: NOT_ASSIGNED. NMEA 0183 manufacturer mnemonic codes cost USD 200 plus purchase of the standard and are issued to companies only (EVD-MC11-004). No code was requested.
nmea0183.productCertification: NOT_CERTIFIED. NMEA 0183 is a copyrighted document licence, not a product-certification scheme in the sense of NMEA 2000; MAREA holds no licence and claims no conformance. No test report, no declaration of conformity to NMEA 0183 and no official sentence conformance exists.
nmea0183.approvedTerminology: PROHIBITED_TERMS_WITHHELD. 'NMEA 0183 compliant', 'NMEA 0183 certified', 'conforms to NMEA 0183' and 'official NMEA 0183 implementation' are prohibited. Permitted wording: 'parses documented NMEA 0183 sentence types' plus the explicit statement that parsing is not conformance.
nmea0183.logoUse: NOT_PERMITTED. No NMEA mark, logo or standard-document extract may be reproduced.
claimsPermitted: MAREA parses a documented subset of NMEA 0183 sentence types; parsing is not conformance to the standard.
NMEA 0183 is a copyrighted standard licensed by NMEA, not a freely redistributable specification.
A documented NMEA 0183 interface must be validated per sentence, per device, per firmware version and per direction before any compatibility row is published.

governanceSources.whatItEstablishes: Certification is mandatory for products that read and/or transmit NMEA 2000 information; manufacturer code and per-product product code are required; the mark is a registered trademark; certification follows validation of an encrypted certification file.

NMEA 0183 is a copyrighted document licensed by NMEA with published price tiers; the electrical/protocol definition is 4800 baud (38.4 kbaud for 0183-HS); manufacturer mnemonic codes are issued to companies for USD 200.
